scope: live MPR-191 readiness smoke on existing CPU cluster; real schema Jobs, kubelet and EndpointSlice controller; no manufactured status
operatorExecution: both production reconcilers in namespace-scoped Linux binary; impersonated test ServiceAccount with namespaced binding to generated source role; shared legacy operator kept running and denied only fixture writes

cases.elapsedScope: resumed observation of an already-held fault; not injection-to-detection latency

elapsedTimeLimit: Functional polling timings, not performance guarantees; endpoint-loss case resumed an existing held fault.
productFix: Preserve deployment.kubernetes.io/revision on Deployment metadata and exclude it from Pod templates to stop generation churn.
attemptNotes: Initial disposable PostgreSQL fixture needed runtime-specific PG_SSLMODE and DATABASE_URL; corrected fixture only.
First complete rollout exposed the product revision-annotation loop; fixed code, added unit/API-server regressions, reran full local suite and live tests.
EndpointSlice checker treated null endpoints as iterable; corrected checker and resumed final six cases with the same fixed binary and fixture.
